title: Thai Cabbage Stew
description: A flavorful Thai-inspired stew made with cabbage, a blend of spices, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add sliced ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
3. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute.
4. Add chopped cabbage and diced stew. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is tender, about 10 minutes.
5. Stir in fish sauce and brown sugar. Cook for 1 minute.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve hot, topped with melted butter and garnished with chopped cilantro, if desired.
8. Serve over steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
9. Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
